title: Three days in Sigiriya — Jen Seymour
creator: jenseymour0
scope: Regional stop within a 2.5-week Sri Lanka trip; not a complete airport-to-airport itinerary

stays.details: Roy's Villa; creator calls it a hostel and says it organised the activities. Property category and room price not stated.

items.details: Arrival-night cooking class followed by eating the curries prepared. Creator says it was free during her stay; present inclusions not established.
Guided cycling through local villages and rice paddies; return to hostel before safari.
Hostel jeep pickup for Minneriya National Park safari, described as 4–5 hours. Creator reports seeing more than 50 elephants; visual evidence confirms elephants, not the count.
Family-style dinner and quiz night at the hostel.
04:30 wake-up for Pidurangala Rock sunrise hike.
Relax at hostel, then take bus to Kandy.
